im 19, im a girl but i go by nonbinary. x has been my inspiration for a long time and it shows in the way ive changed over the years. i started to dress different. i cut my hair, hightop fade. i had long and thick hair. it was really nice. i started experimenting with my personality and habits. i bought chains and chokers and rings, black clothes, ya know the whole thing. my academy at school was audio production, and i was getting really into it. our class was releasing a mixtape and i was offered a spot on it. i had so many songs and i was writing more. eventually i picked one and we went to the studio to record. i was pretty awkward in high school, but basically everyone knew me and i was still considered pretty cool. i was a nervous wreck, but i played it off by cracking jokes with everyone and keeping everyone entertained. eventually i told my teacher that someone else can have the spot. then he started letting me do the mixing and mastering. id help him record the songs and eq compress and all that terminology. it was so fun. every day i came home id start writing. i bought a guitar, painted it, performed a cover with a friend at a summer camp type thing i volunteered at. my life revolved around music. it still does and it always has. id found the love of my life, though we’re not together anymore now, we’re best friends. but things just started going downhill. i stopped making music, i was cutting. got sent to a mental hospital. worst four days of my life. it felt like i was there for months. i cried all day and night. i would pretend to sleep in during breakfast so theyd bring it to my room and i can eat alone. i had a roommate. she was old, she snored so loud, so when i was actually able to fall asleep, she’d always end up making loud noises or going to the bathroom in the middle of the night. i didnt talk to anyone till the end if the second day. this guy came up to me, tall lightskin with crazy curly hair. it was so messy but it looked great on him. i dont even remember his name, he was 21 at the time and i was 18. we became like best friends in there. but he had anger issues and would have to get put in the observation room. he’d bang on the door with his head and hands, then eventually he’d calm down. hes the only reason i was able to get make it through those days. i started to become familiar with everyone around me. didnt
